seed_ledger.name: Seminoe Power Project (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: the plant is now called the Miller Generating Station (about 2,000 MW, 70 acres on Overland Trail Ranch south of Sinclair, Carbon County). Company says a major gas pipeline corridor adjoins the site and an existing pipeline will serve it; no operator, tap or lateral named. Data center tie is only 'one or two' unnamed clients. Wyoming Industrial Siting permit docket DEQ/ISC 26-03 is filed, hearing set for January 2027, and the application (at the Carbon County Clerk) is the place to learn the gas tie. Length unknown. EIA August 2026 workbook has no row for it. No FERC filing, Wyoming air permit or state docket naming a gas line found; FERC eLibrary itself not searchable here. Searches run: 11. Sources: company gas-generation page (corridor adjoins site, no tap named); company June 2026 open house notice (renamed, siting permit); Wyoming DEQ courtesy notice (filing, 2031 start); WyoFile (one or two data center clients, none named); Rawlins Times and Bigfoot99 (same facts); FERC blanket certificate searches (nothing for the site); EIA Aug 2026 workbook (no match).

seed_ledger.name: Vermaland La Osa power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND for a named pipeline, but a length lead: Pinal County staff report and the September 2025 citizen advisory meeting transcript say a gas pipeline extension is needed to the site, about 5 miles to an existing gas line to the west (developer representative, 'I think that's the right number'); the line is unnamed and no sponsor or filing exists. The campus is a data center plus gas plant (final version 500 MW plant, 11 data center buildings) and Pinal County rejected the rezoning 4-1 on Aug 26 2026, so the project is likely dead. Nearest lines are El Paso Gas Pipeline P0184 and the Transwestern expansion P7840, but no source says which one. EIA Aug 2026 workbook has no row. No Arizona Corporation Commission, FERC or air permit filing found. Reconsider if Vermaland resubmits. Searches run: 10. Sources: Pinal County P&Z packet (5-mile extension needed); KJZZ and KTAR (rejection, plant size); Orion Property (project scale); Pinal County and ADEQ air permit searches (nothing filed); ACC and FERC searches (nothing for Eloy); Desert Southwest and Red Chile Lateral coverage (no Eloy delivery point); EIA Aug 2026 (no match).

evidence.note: county packet: extension of gas pipeline required, about 5 miles to the line to the west
rezoning rejected Aug 26 2026; 500 MW gas plant version
